item.title: Women Are Losing Jobs to AI at Triple the Rate of Men—Here’s Why
item.description: A UN study reveals women are three times more likely than men to lose jobs due to AI-driven automation, exposing a stark gender disparity in technological disruption. The findings highlight how automation risks cementing systemic biases, particularly in female-dominated fields like administrative support and customer service.

item.title: Scana Shake-Up: Inside the Sudden CEO Swap and What’s Next for the Energy Giant
item.description: Scana has appointed Baste Tveito as its new CEO, effective May 27, as outgoing CEO Pl Selvik departs, marking a leadership transition aimed at driving the company's next phase of growth. Tveito, previously Scana's COO, brings extensive expertise in oil and gas, systems engineering, and business leadership to the role.

item.title: Wales Bets on Tidal Power with Inyanga’s Bold New Energy Project
item.description: In a major step for marine energy, Inyanga Marine Energy Group has tapped Hutchinson Engineering to fabricate critical components for its HydroWing tidal devices as part of a 20 MW array at Waless Morlais site. The project could cement tidal powers role in the global energy mix and prove Waless claim as a renewables leader.

item.title: UAE’s First Large-Scale Methanol Plant Breaks Ground as Wood Seals Key Contract
item.description: Wood has secured a project management consultancy contract for the UAE's first large-scale methanol plant in Al Ruwais, a $1.7 billion facility set to produce 1.8 million tons of green methanol annually by 2028. The project underscores the UAE's push into sustainable chemicals and Wood's expanding role in the region's downstream sector.

item.title: Germany’s Energy Resilience Gets a Major Lift as Third LNG Terminal Goes Live
item.description: Germanys third LNG import hub, Wilhelmshaven 2, is now operational, delivering 4.6 billion cubic meters of annual regasification capacity to bolster Europes energy resilience and reduce reliance on Russian gas. The project, completed in just 2.5 years, features advanced technology like an ultrasound system to prevent pipe fouling and a first-of-its-kind offshore jetty for minimal environmental impact.

item.title: ESL Shipping Lands €70M to Fuel Its Fleet of Futuristic Eco-Friendly Vessels
item.description: Finlands ESL Shipping has secured 115 million in financing for four methanol-powered bulk carriers, featuring dual-fuel engines and sustainability tech like battery packs and emission-reducing systems. The investment highlights the maritime industrys shift toward decarbonization, with deliveries expected between 2027 and 2028.

item.title: The First Massive Components of Canada’s $5.1 Billion LNG Megaproject Finally Arrive (Photos)
item.description: Woodfibre Management has advanced its $5.1 billion LNG export project in British Columbia with the arrival of the first seven modules, marking a key step toward building the world's first net-zero LNG facility by 2027. The project aims to supply Asian markets with lower-carbon fuel while leveraging hydroelectric power and carbon offsets to meet environmental goals.

item.title: Southeast Asia’s Clean Energy Shift: Singapore and Malaysia Look to Vietnam for Offshore Wind Power
item.description: Southeast Asia's renewable energy transition gains momentum as Singapore, Malaysia, and Vietnam sign a landmark agreement to explore cross-border electricity trading, focusing on Vietnam's offshore wind power through a proposed subsea cable network. The partnership aims to assess the feasibility of supplying Vietnamese wind energy to Singapore via Malaysia's grid, potentially reshaping ASEAN's energy future.

item.title: Hutchinson Engineering Lands Major Tidal Energy Deal with Inyanga Marine Group
item.description: Wales is making a major push into tidal energy with the 20 MW HydroWing array at the Morlais site, one of Europe's largest tidal projects, aiming to position the country as a leader in underwater renewables. The project, backed by significant investment and set for deployment in 2026, highlights tidal energy's potential to compete with wind and solar while offering predictable power generation.

item.title: UAE Becomes First Nation to Offer Free ChatGPT Plus to Every Citizen
item.description: The UAE has made ChatGPT Plus free for all citizens and residents, marking a strategic move in its ambitious plan to build the world's largest AI supercomputing cluster with partners like OpenAI and Nvidia. This initiative positions Abu Dhabi as a global AI hub while sparking geopolitical debates about AI sovereignty and competition.
